STATEMENT OF WORK NO. 1
Under the Master Services Agreement dated March 3, 2024
Between Northstar Analytics, Inc. ("Provider") and Ridgeline Manufacturing
Corp. ("Customer").

Effective Date: March 15, 2024.

1. SCOPE. Provider shall design, build, and deploy a factory-floor telemetry
integration between Customer's Cleveland facility (Line A and Line B) and
Provider's Nova analytics platform, including:
  (a) Deployment of edge collectors on 42 CNC machines;
  (b) Real-time ingestion pipeline handling not less than 100,000 events per
      minute at 99.9% monthly uptime;
  (c) Two operational dashboards (yield and throughput);
  (d) Training for up to 15 Customer personnel.

2. MILESTONES.
  M1 - Environment provisioning and data-map sign-off .... April 30, 2024
  M2 - Pilot cutover on Line A ........................... June 15, 2024
  M3 - Production cutover on Lines A and B ............... August 30, 2024
  M4 - Acceptance and go-live ............................ September 30, 2024

3. FEES. Total fixed fee: $480,000, invoiced as follows:
  - 25% ($120,000) on execution of this SOW;
  - 25% ($120,000) on completion of M2;
  - 30% ($144,000) on completion of M3;
  - 20% ($96,000) on Acceptance under Section 4.

4. ACCEPTANCE. Customer shall have fifteen (15) business days after
Provider's written notice of completion of M4 to test the deliverables against
the acceptance criteria in Exhibit A. Customer shall provide a written notice
of acceptance or a written notice of non-conformance identifying specific
failures. Failure to provide either notice within the acceptance period shall
constitute acceptance.

5. CHANGE ORDERS. Any change to scope, milestones, or fees requires a written
change order signed by both parties.

Signed by authorized representatives, March 15, 2024.
